title: How to Earn HashCoins: Play, Stream, Book and Refer
description: Every way to earn HashCoins on the Hash app: play tournaments, stream tournaments, book gaming cafe slots and refer friends. Plus what you can redeem them on.

body.text: HashCoins are the rewards you collect on Hash For Gamers, the free gaming app for India. You earn them for things you already do as a gamer, and you can redeem them on passes, offers and gear. Here is every way to earn them.

Every match you play in a Hash tournament earns HashCoins. Winners also get rewards sent straight to their Hash wallet. Tournaments run across BGMI, Free Fire, Valorant, Call of Duty Mobile, EA FC, Clash Royale and Tekken.
Streamers earn HashCoins by streaming tournaments on the app. If you already create gaming content, this turns your streams into rewards.
Book a PC or console at a gaming cafe near you on Hash and every booking earns HashCoins. It is also the cheapest way to play big releases like GTA 6 without buying a console.
Bring your squad to Hash. Every friend you refer earns you HashCoins.
Download Hash, join a tournament or book a slot, and start stacking HashCoins today.
